description: Chain-centric validator operations dashboard. MASTERCHAIN and SHARDCHAIN contain the same panel set with fixed chain filters; node-level storage is shown separately.

panels.description: Current successful validation rate by chain.
panels.title: Successful validations/s

panels.description: Time to a ready decision for 95% of successfully validated candidates.
panels.title: Validation p95

panels.description: End-to-end successful candidate build duration at the 95th percentile.

panels.description: Number of rejected validation results for masterchain over the selected dashboard range. Zero is healthy.

panels.description: Number of deadline validation results for masterchain over the selected dashboard range. Zero is healthy.
panels.title: Deadlines

panels.title: Unsuccessful validations

panels.title: Validation candidate size p95

panels.description: Consensus progress rate by chain. A sustained zero during an active session needs investigation.
panels.title: Finalized slots

panels.description: Certificates by kind. Rising skip certificates while finalization stays flat indicate slots without a block.
panels.title: Consensus certificates

panels.description: Local voting decisions stacked by outcome.
panels.title: Consensus votes

panels.description: Mean signatures in each stored certificate by kind. A decline reveals participation loss before consensus stops.

targets.expr: sum by (chain, kind) (rate(${metric_namespace}_validator_consensus_certificate_signatures_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",chain="masterchain"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (chain, kind) (rate(${metric_namespace}_validator_consensus_certificates_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",chain="masterchain"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Signatures per certificate

panels.title: Produced candidate size p95

panels.description: Exact contents of the latest candidate produced by this node, stacked by item type. Each scraped value is exact; when multiple candidates are produced between Prometheus scrapes, only the latest one is visible.

panels.description: Positive schedule lateness. Shardchain build_start excludes the first slot of each window and shows only carry-over between sequential candidates; masterchain build_start and broadcast include every slot.

panels.title: Deadlines and pressure

panels.description: Cleanup stop reasons. Rising budget means the wall-clock budget is binding; block_full means the block limit is binding.
panels.title: Out-queue cleanup

panels.description: Any non-zero value is abnormal: spec rejection, self-rejection, persistence failure, backstop, or producer alarm.
